annotations.title: Pilot 02: federal contracts and lobbying reports of an AI or robotics company

description: For one AI or robotics company, return how it is linked to federal identifiers (each USAspending UEI and LDA client with the basis of the link) and its records: federal contract awards from USAspending.gov (last 24 months, at most 100) and Lobbying Disclosure Act reports from LDA.gov (2025-2026). Every record field is copied verbatim from the source, with source_url. Organizations only; no campaign-finance data. Omit company to list the companies covered. Counts are computed by Seraphix, not source figures.

company.description: Company name or slug, e.g. Palantir or intuitive-surgical. Omit to list companies.

name: pilot02_follow_the_money

cite.description: Cite this: the attribution line for this response (CC BY 4.0). Records: cite each by its record_url.
